lose_weight.title: Lose Weight
lose_weight.description: This plan focuses on calorie deficit through a combination of cardio and strength training to maximize fat loss while preserving muscle.

gain_muscle.title: Gain Muscle
gain_muscle.description: This plan is designed for muscle hypertrophy with progressive overload in strength training and a protein-rich diet.

maintain_fitness.title: Maintain Fitness
maintain_fitness.description: This plan provides a balanced routine of strength, cardio, and flexibility to maintain your current fitness level and overall health.

warmup.title: Warm-up (10 mins)
items: Dynamic stretches: leg swings, arm circles, torso twists.

technique.title: Technique Focus (5 mins)
technique.description: Practice proper form for barbell squats with an empty bar. Focus on depth and keeping your chest up.

main.title: Main Workout (45 mins)
items: Dumbbell Bench Press: 3 sets of 10-12 reps.
Pull-ups (or lat pulldowns): 3 sets to failure.

stretching.title: Stretching (10 mins)
stretching.description: Static stretches for major muscle groups: quads, hamstrings, chest, back, and shoulders. Hold each stretch for 30 seconds.

lose_weight.title: Cardio & Core Burn
lose_weight.focus: Focus: Calorie Burn and Core Strength

warmup.title: Warm-up (5 mins)
items: 2 minutes of high knees and butt kicks.

technique.title: Circuit (30 mins)
technique.description: Complete 3 rounds of the following circuit, with 60 seconds rest between rounds.

stretching.title: Cool-down (10 mins)
stretching.description: Light jogging followed by full-body static stretching. Hold each stretch for 30 seconds.

warmup.title: Mobility Warm-up (10 mins)
items: Thoracic Spine Windmills: 10 reps each side.
World's Greatest Stretch: 5 reps each side.

technique.title: Balance & Stability
technique.description: Practice single-leg deadlifts with no weight to improve balance.

main.title: Main Workout (40 mins)
items: Bird-Dog: 3 sets of 12 reps each side.

stretching.title: Yoga Flow (10 mins)
stretching.description: Finish with a simple yoga flow including Downward-Facing Dog, Warrior I, and Child's Pose.
